title: Sequence upgrade notifications and customer migration guide for LTS rollouts
creator: Anika Patel
description: Create a staged, customer-facing upgrade playbook for LTS channel upgrades that combines: (1) an email/SMS/console notification sequence, (2) a concise migration guide for common breaking changes, (3) templated changelog entries, and (4) rollout gates and canary cohort guidance. Goal: reduce support load during LTS upgrades and increase adoption of the LTS channel while minimizing runtime regressions for customers on private/dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 3 channel-tailored notification templates (general announcement, 2-week reminder, 48-hour action required) with legal-approved copy
A one-page migration quickstart covering the top 5 breaking changes with clear code examples and rollback steps
A repo of changelog snippets mapped to feature flags and upgrade risk labels
Rollout gate checklist documented and agreed by Eng, SRE, and Solutions ENG
Comms tested with 5 pilot customers and updated based on feedback
tasks: Draft initial notification sequence and subject lines
Work with Legal to finalize phrasing for data and SLA language
Coordinate with ENG to identify top 5 breaking changes and automated migration scripts
Author one-page migration quickstart and detailed migration playbook
Create changelog snippet library and tagging scheme
Design canary cohort definitions and rollout gate triggers
Prepare customer-facing FAQ and support escalation playbook
Run pilot with 5 selected customers and collect feedback
Publish final materials to Support Portal, Console banner templates, and Marketing automation
comm_templates: Initial announcement (HTML + plain text) - includes migration link, LTS benefits, opt-out instructions
Two-week reminder - highlights breaking changes and scheduled window
48-hour action required - last chance to schedule migration or request deferral
Console banner blurb (50 chars and 200 char variants)
Support triage escalation template for customer success
migration_quickstart_summary: Top-level quick actions: 1) pin runtime version in config; 2) verify KV cache eviction policy change via sample request; 3) update SDK to v3.2 for new structured output format; 4) toggle 'legacy-tokenizer' flag if using custom tokenization; 5) run provided compatibility checker script against production sample traffic.
rollout_gates: Gate 1: Automated compatibility checks pass for >=95% of sampled tenant configs
Gate 2: Canary cohort (2% of traffic across 10 tenants) shows no increase in 5xx and latency within SLO for 48h
Gate 3: Observability smoke tests (tracing, token-cost regression, KV cache hitrate) within thresholds
Gate 4: Customer success sign-off for top 10 customers with bespoke integrations
Gate 5: Legal/Security sign-off on comms language and data handling notes
rollback_plan: Immediate: schedule automated rollback to previous pinned LTS artifact using infra playbook
Notify affected customers via the escalation template and create a dedicated support channel
Post-incident: run RCA, add remedial tests to the rollout gate checklist, and update migration guide
Compensations: coordinate with finance for credits if SLA breach confirmed

Timing conflicts with other major tenant migrations could amplify support load
